cases.requirement: A cold start must include the relevant public/consumer acceptance path.
cases.forbidden: Treating internal byte/hash evidence as GREEN without a public consumer outcome.
cases.public_acceptance: A fresh consumer path is exercised or explicitly fails closed before a success claim.

cases.requirement: A terminal handoff must carry the exact next action and provider-safe launch information.
cases.forbidden: Stopping or emitting a terminal handoff with no executable exact-next carrier.
cases.public_acceptance: The next action is recoverable from committed artifacts without raw session access.

cases.requirement: The approved goal controls return scope unless a typed finding changes the transition.
cases.forbidden: Letting an incidental diagnostic or stale carrier redefine the approved scope.
cases.public_acceptance: A returned result either satisfies the approved goal or records a scoped, auditable transition.

cases.requirement: Audit retry/terminal behavior must be enforced as a runtime transition, not only described in prose.
cases.forbidden: Continuing repeated audits past the declared cap without a typed exception or owner boundary.
cases.public_acceptance: The terminal audit state is observable and routes to a bounded next action.

cases.requirement: Retain a clean bounded control when judging reliability; do not overgeneralize failures.
cases.forbidden: Claiming every historical task failed or treating all journal deviation as product failure.
cases.public_acceptance: The control remains separately identifiable and is not scored as a critical failure.
